sources.title: Special Token Injection (STI) Attack Guide
sources.snippet: AI Red Team Special Token Injection (STI) Attack Guide Large Language Models introduce security issues reminiscent of early-2000s software bugs. Special Token Injection (STI) exploits how LLMs parse structured prompts. This post breaks down what STI is, how it works, where it appears, and why it matters—through a pentester's lens.
